label: Genes as HGNC symbol and NCBI gene IDs per pathway
description: Lists, for every pathway of a species, the HGNC symbols and NCBI gene identifiers of its gene products as two comma-separated sets. This output can be used to compare against existing gene list, e.g. from PubTator or PFOCR. The query also retrieves a count of each database and of the gene product nodes that carry neither cross-reference. The symbols and identifiers are independent sets, not aligned pairs, because a node may carry one cross-reference and not the other. There is deliberately no ORDER BY: sorting makes Virtuoso store the concatenated lists in a temporary column capped at about 2000 characters, which the largest pathways exceed (SR319).
